subject.title: fix(xai): bound stalled generated video download body reads

question: What idle-versus-wall-clock timeout policy should xAI generated-video downloads use so stalled bodies fail distinctly without rejecting healthy slow CDN transfers?
rationale: The current operation timeout defines only a hard wall-clock budget; selecting a separate idle threshold changes provider behavior and should be coordinated with the sibling video-download work.

options.title: Add a shorter shared idle ceiling
options.body: Use a named provider-download idle ceiling below the hard request deadline and share the policy with sibling video providers.

options.title: Keep one hard deadline
options.body: Remove the redundant chunk timer and retain the existing generic request timeout rather than promising a distinct idle diagnostic.

options.title: Pause for cross-provider design
options.body: Coordinate this PR with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108982 before changing any provider's timeout semantics.

recommendation.title: Add a shorter shared idle ceiling
recommendation.body: Use a named provider-download idle ceiling below the hard request deadline and share the policy with sibling video providers.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the xAI provider timeout defaults and are the strongest history-backed candidate to calibrate the intended policy.
